[!dolt] skip
# Test bd label add/list/remove flows
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Issue for labels' --description 'Label target' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd label add $ISSUE backend
stdout 'Added label'

bd label add $ISSUE urgent
stdout 'Added label'

bd label list $ISSUE
stdout 'backend'
stdout 'urgent'

bd label remove $ISSUE urgent
stdout 'Removed label'

bd label list $ISSUE
stdout 'backend'
! stdout 'urgent'

bd label list-all
stdout 'backend'
